name: filter-doc-list
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is (.*)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" using "\\2" as list

name: filter-default-string
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is (.*)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" using "\\2"

name: filter-as-string
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is (.*)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" using "\\2" as string

name: filter-separator
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is (.*)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" using "\\2" separator ", "

name: filter-default-using
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1"

name: filter-duplicates-false
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) (is)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" using "\\2" as list without duplicates

name: filter-duplicates-true
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) (is)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" using "\\2" as list with duplicates

name: filter-duplicates-string
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) (is)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" using "\\2" without duplicates

name: filter-no-match
script: filter text "zzz" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\0"

name: filter-key-template
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is (\\w+)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "[\\1-\\2]" using "\\0"

name: filter-case-insensitive
script: filter text "^(john) is (.*)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" using "\\2" without case sensitive

name: filter-regexpflag
script: filter text "(A.*)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "k" using "\\1" regexpflag {"MULTILINE"}

name: filter-syntax
script: filter text "\\(J[a-z]*\\)" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" syntax "GREP"

name: filter-invalid-regexp
script: filter text "(" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "a"

name: filter-missing-key
script: filter text "a" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps"

name: filter-missing-in
script: filter text "a" key "b"

name: filter-unicode-keys
script: filter text "(\\S+)" in "é e z É a Z" key "\\1"

name: filter-empty-key
script: filter text "(x)?a" in "a a" key "\\1"

name: filter-special-chars
script: filter text "(.+)" in "<a & b>" key "k<&>" using "\\1"

name: filter-in-file
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is (.*)" in POSIX file "$FILES/people.txt" key "\\1" using "\\2" as list

name: filter-into-file
script:
filter text "^([A-z]+) is (.*)" in POSIX file "$FILES/people.txt" key "\\1" using "\\2" into POSIX file "$TMP/out.plist"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/out.plist"

name: filter-template-error
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\5"

name: filter-as-other
script: filter text "^([A-z]+) is" in "John is ten" & linefeed & "Anna is twelve" & linefeed & "John is at school" & linefeed & "Anna sleeps" key "\\1" as record

name: filter-whole-word
script: filter text "(is)" in "this is" key "\\1" with whole word

name: filter-numbers-in-text
script: filter text "([0-9]+)" in "a1 b22 c1" key "n" using "\\1" as list
